import java.util.*;

public class MaxFlow {

    static final int NN = 202;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int[][] flow = new int[NN][NN];
    static int[][] cap = new int[NN][NN];
    static int[] pre = new int[NN];
    static int[] que = new int[NN];
    static int[] d = new int[NN];
    static char[][] a = new char[11][11];
    static char[][] b = new char[11][11];

    static int bi, bj;
    static int[][] dir = { {0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0} };
    static int[][] mat = new int[101][101];
    static int n, t;

    static List<Integer> ca = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> cb = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> cc = new ArrayList<>();

    static int edmondsKarp(int n, int source, int sink) {
        int maxFlow = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            Arrays.fill(d, 0);
            d[source] = INF;
            int p = 0, q = 0;
            que[q++] = source;

            while (p < q && pre[sink] < 0) {
                int t = que[p++];
                for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
                    if (pre[i] < 0 && (j=cap[t][i]-flow[t][i]) > 0) {
                        pre[i] = t;
                        d[i] = Math.min(d[t], j);
                        que[q++] = i;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pre[sink] < 0) break;
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i=pre[i]) {
                flow[pre[i]][i] += d[sink];
                flow[i][pre[i]] -= d[sink];
            }
            maxFlow += d[sink];
        }
        return maxFlow;
    }

    static void solve(int A, int B, int[] vis, boolean check) {
        Queue<int[]> que = new LinkedList<>();
        int sizeA = A * n + B;
        vis[sizeA] = 0;
        que.offer(new int[]{A, B});
        while (!que.isEmpty()) {
            int[] now = que.poll();
            int pIdx = now[0] * n + now[1];
            int dis = vis[pIdx];

            if (check && (mat[bi * n + bj][pIdx] <= dis || t <= dis)) {
                if (mat[bi * n + bj][pIdx] < dis || t < dis) {
                    vis[pIdx] = INF + 1;
                }
                continue;
            }

            for (int d=0; d<4; d++) {
                int i = dir[d][0] + now[0];
                int j = dir[d][1] + now[1];

                if (i<0 || j<0 || i>=n || j>=n) continue;
                if (b[i][j]<'0' || b[i][j]>'9') continue;
                int qIdx = i*n + j;
                if (vis[qIdx] != INF) continue;
                vis[qIdx] = dis +1;
                que.offer(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }
    }

    static void build() {
        ca.clear();
        cb.clear();
        cc.clear();

        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (b[i][j]<'0' || b[i][j]>'9') continue;
                ca.add(i);
                cb.add(j);
                int p = i*n + j;
                cap[p+2 + n * n][1] = b[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
        int z = bi * n + bj;
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j]<'0' || a[i][j]>'9') continue;
                int p = i*n + j;
                cap[0][p+2] = a[i][j] - '0';
                for (int k=0; k<ca.size(); k++) {
                    int ii = ca.get(k);
                    int jj = cb.get(k);
                    int qIdx = ii * n + jj;
                    if (mat[p][qIdx] < INF)
                        cap[p+2][qIdx+2 + n * n] = INF;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            a[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            b[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bi = i;
                    bj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mat[i], INF);
        }
        solve(bi, bj, mat[bi * n + bj], false);
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] >= '1' && a[i][j] <= '9') {
                    solve(i, j, mat[i*n + j], true);
                }
            }
        }
        build();
        System.out.println(edmondsKarp(2 + n * n, 0, 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
